items.label: Executable content requirements (Catalog companion)
items.description: Deliver executable workflow requirements and offline fixtures without installing runtimes.

clientCapabilities.reason: Companion file format only; native loading not observed.

Browser p5.js template runtime; supplied template CDN version remains unchanged. Explicit browser/CDN network required; not a Node CLI or automatic installation. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.
API credentials and explicit paid invocation are separate. Stub fixture makes no model request. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Claude CLI/session required only by run_eval/run_loop; description improvement needs API credentials. Validation and report generation are offline. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.
Optional separate backend; credentials/model invocation are never part of installation. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Pillow GIF fixture does not use FFmpeg; video conversion needs separately sourced FFmpeg 9.0.2 binary/codec distribution. imageio-ffmpeg bundled binary is not that candidate. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Playwright-managed Chromium build and OS libraries must be bound explicitly; Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.47 is a separate explicit route. Windows arm64 Chrome for Testing blocked. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

PPTX extraction and ReportLab PDF are separate from browser HTML export. HTML export needs Node 26.12.1 and Playwright 1.64.1/browser. Font files and licences need exact identities. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

macOS only: Swift 6.4.1, AppKit/Foundation and exact SDK. iconify route also needs explicit backend/credentials; no native Linux fallback. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Node 26.12.1; remotion and @remotion/google-fonts 4.0.539, React 19.3.1. Renderer/browser/font/FFmpeg 9.0.2 distributor closure unresolved. Do not silently use imageio bundled FFmpeg. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.
Cairo/Pango/LaTeX/fonts and FFmpeg 9.0.2 binary/codec closure unresolved; no host compilation. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.
Service credentials, websocket and paid operations require explicit activation. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.
pytest is optional test-only. Agent-running paths require explicit Claude client/session. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Preserved upstream historical orchestration. Use separately delivered web-artifacts-builder-modern; never execute global pnpm install or floating Parcel path by default. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Node 26.12.1 for helper/server; POSIX start/stop scripts require Bash and OS process tools. Explicit loopback/port and owned-process deadline; Windows wrapper unqualified. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Node 26.12.1 and Graphviz 16.1 dot with exact native package; rendering may invoke graph descriptions. Native package/font closure pending. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Explicit WezTerm stable 20240203-110809-5046fc22; platform terminal alternatives need observed OS package and argv. PowerShell (powershell.exe) and pwsh are separate. X11 and Wayland are separate; no automatic launch. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Bash and observed shell utility packages. gh 2.103.3 is optional only for selected GitHub operations; authentication/account actions remain explicit. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

POSIX Bash process/pipe/flock/ps/kill/stat/date semantics require actual OS-package observations. Windows routes WSL-only until ported. Guardian activity heuristics do not prove safe idle detection. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Node 26.12.1; Git/client-specific integrations and network/account prerequisites are per asset. No client activation, hooks installation or guessed provider substitution. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Standard-library evaluator/gate/gacha; any optional external service remains caller-selected. No claim of semantic evaluation from heuristic output. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Bash/POSIX and actual installed utility capability/argv observations required; native Windows not qualified, WSL2 distinct. Never install or upgrade all host utilities. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

Client-owned Python/Node/TypeScript or cmd hook protocol. Actual host runtime, client loading, approvals and event bindings remain separately qualified. Exact artifact closure unresolved; byte delivery is not executable readiness.

activation.instructions: Read SKILL.md and inspect workflow.mjs plan. Acquire exact isolated artifacts separately; no execution from material Apply.
